comaraderie.title: COMaraderie
comaraderie.body: Comaraderie is an annual event held by SoC to help students kickstart the new semester with new friendships and experiences after the long winter break. Participants form groups of 5 and complete various challenges to win attractive prizes, making new friends along the way.

career_launchpad.title: Career Launchpad
career_launchpad.body: Career Launchpad 2026 is an initiative by the NUS Computing Club's Academic Liaison Cell aimed at preparing students for successful careers. It includes skill-building workshops, company talks, and alumni sharing sessions, focusing on delivering insights and meaningful takeaways to empower attendees in their career journeys.

ffc.title: Freshmen Finale Camp 2026
ffc.body:
🍽️ HUNGRY FOR THE WIN? THE FEAST AWAITS! 🔥
The Grand Feast has returned to SoC, and four clans are ready to battle for the top spot!
Join us for Freshman Finale Camp (FFC) 2026 as Iolite, Citrine, Peridot and Andesine enter The Hunger Trails - a camp-wide adventure filled with games, bonding, challenges and unforgettable memories. 🏕️✨
This is not just about food.
This is about being hungry for fun, hungry for friends, and hungry for victory. 🏆
Throughout the camp, you will compete for Feast Points, meet fellow SoC freshmen and seniors, explore the SoC spirit, and celebrate the start of your NUS journey through exciting activities and beach-day fun! 🌊🍜
🏆 WHY JOIN FFC '26? 🏆
⭐️ Compete in station games, mass games and beach challenges 🔥
⭐️ Join one of four clans and fight for the Champion of the Feast title 🍽️
⭐️ Meet new friends, seniors and future coursemates 💗
⭐️ Experience SoC, NUS and Singapore culture through camp-wide activities 🇸🇬
⭐️ End off with a Grand Feast celebration by the beach 🌊✨
Step into the Hunger Trails and feed your hunger for victory.
📝 IMPORTANT DATES
Camp: Aug 4th - 6th
Eligibility: Incoming SoC Freshmen
Questions? DM us on Telegram:
@tkaixinn
@nghnaomi
@hminnn_1

rag_and_flag_day.title: RAG & Flag Day 2026
rag_and_flag_day.body: Rag and Flag is an annual event at NUS that brings together students from various faculties to participate in community service and fundraising activities. The day begins with students engaging in volunteer work across different locations, followed by a vibrant parade featuring student performances and creatively decorated floats. This event not only fosters a sense of unity and social responsibility among students but also helps raise funds for various charitable causes. Rag and Flag embodies the spirit of giving back to the community while celebrating student creativity and teamwork.
